name: create-formal-verification-skill
description: Formally verify one property of the code where a bug costs most and tests reach least, then write a project-local verify skill for it. Use for 'model-check this race', 'prove this invariant', or a costly race, retry, or state-machine bug.

findings.excerpt: Run Quint at a pinned version, for example `npx --yes @informalsystems/quint@0.33.0`, or add it as a pinned dev dependency of the repo. Use the `quint` command
"Runs Quint at a pinned version (for example npx @informalsystems/quint@<version> or a pinned dev dependency), not a global install or an unpinned quint"
